Poem of Gilgameš – Standard Babylonian I: “[He Who Saw The Deep, The] Foundation Of The Country”

  • Source: eBL corpus – https://www.ebl.lmu.de/corpus/L/1/4/Standard%20Babylonian/I
  • API: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/api/texts/L/1/4/chapters/Standard%20Babylonian/I/display
  • Edition: Andrew R. George (editor); Geraldina Rozzi (revision); Enrique Jiménez (revision)
  • Translation: Andrew R. George; Anmar A. Fadhil; Wasim Khatabe
  • Generated by tools/ebl_fetch.py on 2026-10-16 – do not edit by hand; re-run the tool instead.

Per line: N = normalized Akkadian reconstruction (| metrical foot, || caesura); T = eBL English translation; L = lemmas with eBL dictionary glosses; then notes, parallel lines, and the manuscripts' transliterations (ATF). Bibliography keys like [RN117: 889] are resolved in bibliography.md (RN117 = George 2003).

297

  • N: [ultu?] šamhat | šunāti (|) gilgāmeš || ītamâ | ana enkīdu
  • T: [After] Šamḫat told Enkidu the dreams of Gilgameš,
  • L: [ultu?] ← ištu I “from, out of”; šamhat ← Šamhat I; šunāti ← šuttu I “pl. šunātu(m) dream š. naṭālu, amāru etc. to have a dream, to…”; gilgāmeš ← Gilgameš I; ītamâ ← awû I “to speak”; ana ← ana I “(aš-š... etc.) to, for (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n…”; enkīdu ← Enkidu I
  • Note: [RN1428: 52–54] defends that lines 297–298 should be excised: “If these lines, attested on one manuscript from Kuyunjik and two from Babylon (…), were removed, then the dreams would revert to being recounted by the narrator, as in the Old Babylonian version. The inconsistency in what Šamhat says to Enkidu would cease to be. These lines were therefore very probably inserted into a pre-existing version.”
